statement: The reported 12.9 billion dollar Nvidia acquisition of Hugging Face is confirmed closed, meaning the transaction has legally completed, between 2026-09-03 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: A joint Nvidia and Hugging Face press release, or an Nvidia SEC filing, states the acquisition has closed within the window, checked by 2026-12-03.
failure_condition: No joint announcement or SEC filing confirms the deal has closed within the window; a signed definitive agreement without closing, continued regulatory review, or deal abandonment all count as a MISS.
